date.description: The day it is claimed: within the pack's dates (twelve months from the supply, five years at most) and not after today.

f5_period_end.description: The last day of the GST return period the claim goes in; on or after the claim's date.

note.description: The steps taken to recover the debt, or the debtor's insolvency, in plain words; files attach to the claim as evidence.
examples: Three reminders and a letter of demand

write_off_id.description: The posted bad-debt write-off to claim relief for; each is claimed once.
